mainEntity.name: How much does Answer Engine Optimization for pest control typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for Answer Engine Optimization services for a pest control business can vary widely depending on the scope of work, the size of your website, and the competitiveness of your service area. Factors influencing cost include content creation (e.g., new FAQ pages, blog posts), existing website structure optimization, technical SEO for schema markup, and ongoing monitoring and adjustments. Small-scale projects might start from a few hundred dollars per month, while comprehensive, ongoing campaigns could range from several hundred to over a thousand dollars monthly. It's an investment aimed at securing direct answers and increased leads.
